intro.text: Stillmark the Noble, one of Hallandren's oldest Returned: a firm traditionalist who is set against war with Idris.

items.text: When the Court of Gods hears arguments for and against war with Idris, his high priest Nanrovah speaks against it on Stillmark's behalf.

appearance.text: His colours are blue and gold.

personality.text: A staunch traditionalist who opposes most proposals put to the court, and above all war with Idris. Most of the other gods think him wise, which gives him real influence.
